control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 4 baseline compliance implementation

implemented-requirements.description: Intercepts all prompt traffic in-memory before reaching LLMs. Evaluates presented object locators against active signed snapshots with zero DB calls.
Enforces destination egress classes (internal_only vs commercial_cloud) mapped to target models. Prevents unauthorized egress of sensitive data.
Produces immutable AuditLogEntry containing timestamp, mode, verdict, reason codes, locators, clearance, and sub-millisecond decision latency.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: AuditLogEntry dataclass & in-memory audit emission

implemented-requirements.description: Audit records are serialized and committed to an append-only WORM cryptographic audit ledger with immutable hash chains.
Attestation records and snapshots are encapsulated within DSSE envelopes. Public keys in keyring provide unforgeable non-repudiation.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: DSSE RFC 9421 envelopes & Ed25519 keyring verification

implemented-requirements.description: Payloads transmitted across agent networks are wrapped in <pod:delegate> containers carrying cryptographically chained Ed25519 signatures.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: In-Memory Prevalidator Gate & Signed Multi-Hop Handoffs

implemented-requirements.description: Employs strict Ed25519 asymmetric cryptography with dynamic key discovery, key pinning, and zero-downtime rotation.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: Keyring Ed25519 public key management & rotation

implemented-requirements.description: Utilizes standard Ed25519 signatures and SHA-256 digests over canonical UTF-8 representations.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: DSSE v1.0 signature verification & content digest chaining

implemented-requirements.description: Validates hash integrity of presented prompt payloads against signed snapshot records, blocking tampered payloads immediately.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: Snapshot SHA-256 Merkle verification & hash drift detection

implemented-requirements.description: Authenticates callers using signed JWT tokens or API keys, mapping identities into clearance tiers.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: X-POD-Caller-Token JWT validation & clearance mapping

implemented-requirements.description: Autonomous agents must present cryptographically signed delegation envelopes containing verified provenance chains rooted in an accountable human principal.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: <pod:delegate> provenance chains with accountable root owner

implemented-requirements.description: Features continuous in-memory sweepers and an Audit Runway Monitor tracking traffic coverage, denial stability, and triage disposition.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: 30-Day Audit Runway Monitor & in-memory state sweepers
